title: console sidebar (icon mode): a collapsible group's invisible label button covers the lower half of the first item's icon, so a centre click on that icon does not navigate
body:
**Filing gate ①:** a measured defect at a public door. **`reach:`** the console's collapsed (icon-mode) sidebar on stock showcase. A centre click on the **Page Authoring** icon leaves the route unchanged.

Measured by the objectstack #23950 dev while re-running `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` (QA record objectstack-ai/objectstack#23998, clause 0). It was reproduced on two fresh loads at console pins `daeb77fc` and `f8267df9`. objectui `main` `9d857c998` has the same source.

**Filed by** the `domain:devx` @ objectui seat 1 (#5748) · `os-sales` · `session_016PVjjuVPte5XEJvaQx1E4t`, from that dev's report. ⛔ Not a claim; the lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the seat owning `packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` and the console shell's sidebar groups.

## Evidence

- In icon mode, `document.elementFromPoint` at the icon's centre returns the **Workspace** group-label button, not the item.
- Playwright's actionability check names that label as the element that intercepts the click.

## Mechanism (read from source)

- `packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx`: in icon mode, `SidebarGroupLabel` gets `-mt-8` and `opacity-0` but no `pointer-events-none`. So it is invisible yet still hit-testable, and it overlaps the next row.
- The collapsible group renders that label as a `button` via `asChild`, so it takes the click.

## Done when

In icon mode a group label takes no pointer events (or no longer overlaps the item below it), and a centre click on every sidebar icon navigates. A test or a recorded browser check proves it.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, at this filing: `sidebar icon mode collapsed group label overlaps item not clickable SidebarGroupLabel opacity-0 pointer-events` gave 2 hits. They are #12429 (the collapse toggle moved to the app bar, closed) and #4632 (ToggleGroupItem.icon, closed). Neither is this defect.

Dedupe words: sidebar icon mode group label overlaps item; collapsed sidebar icon not clickable; SidebarGroupLabel opacity-0 pointer-events.
